sections.line: For you who has tried everything.

image.alt: Low sunlight scattering across the surface of still water.

sections.heading: Perhaps you have already been tested, and everything came back fine.
paragraphs: Perhaps you have not, and you are only beginning to wonder. Either way, you know your own body, and you know that something is not as it should be.

You may have bought the serums. Read the labels. Tried the thing your friend swore by, and the thing the internet swore by. That space, between everything you have tried and everything you were promised, is a lonely one to stand in. Saede is the help that meets you there.
When you lose your hair, you can lose a little of yourself with it. We know that feeling, and we know how quietly it is usually carried.
sections.statement: Saede is here to help you find your way back to yourself. There is always hope — and you do not have to work it out alone.
sections.plain: Full-dose support for women facing hair loss, chronic stress, and the hormonal imbalance underneath it.

sections.sub: It is the most common cause of hair loss in women, and most of us are never given the name for it.

sections.heading: Not another biotin supplement.
paragraphs: Most hair supplements are built around biotin and a handful of vitamins. They are made for hair that is thinning because something is missing from the diet. That is one cause — and in women, it is rarely the main one.

**Female pattern hair loss — androgenetic alopecia — works differently.** It comes down to how your follicles respond to androgens, and to **DHT** in particular: a hormone your body converts from testosterone. Follicles sensitive to it produce finer, shorter hairs with each cycle, until eventually they stop. It usually shows first at the parting and the temples, and it very often arrives alongside stress, hormonal shifts, or the years after a difficult period.

It affects an enormous number of women, and it remains strikingly under-researched compared with the same condition in men. Which is why so much of what is sold to us is a vitamin with good packaging.

Saede is formulated around those mechanisms instead: the androgen pathway, the cortisol and stress side, the hormonal and metabolic picture underneath, and the nutrients hair is actually built from — all at the amounts the research used.
We looked for a single product that did all of it for women, and we could not find one. So we are making it.
sections.statement: Not a general hair vitamin. A supplement made specifically for women living with female pattern hair loss. If this is what you have been searching for, you can stop looking.
sections.plain: Saede is a food supplement, formulated for women with androgenetic alopecia. It is support alongside proper medical care, not a replacement for it — androgenetic alopecia is a medical condition, so please see a doctor about it too.

sections.quote: I was coming out of the shower to my mother with my arms full of hair, sobbing. Look at this. I don't know what to do. I'm so scared.
paragraphs: Saede is not a brand that found a gap in a market. It is one woman building the thing she spent years, and a great deal of money, trying to assemble for herself — because nobody would help her do it.

Nobody ever gave her the words *androgenetic alopecia*. Without them, she could not even search. It took a stranger on TikTok, at the end of her degree, to say the one thing every doctor had left out.

sections.heading: You are not fighting separate battles. You are fighting one system out of balance.
paragraphs: Hair loss. Acne. Gut issues. Irregular or painful cycles. Anxiety. PCOS. Most women are told these are five separate problems with five separate answers, sent to five different specialists, and handed five things that each treat one symptom.

They are not five problems. So often they trace back to the same roots: chronic stress and cortisol, hormonal and androgen imbalance, and the nutrient gaps underneath. No one connected the dots for you. We do.
sections.caption: Saede is built for the centre of this diagram, not the edges.
statements: Your body is not the enemy. It is asking for help.
We at Saede are here to help you understand it.

sections.heading: Everything you need.
paragraphs: Most supplements list impressive ingredients, then use amounts too small to do very much. A long label sells well. A full dose costs more to make.
Saede is built the other way round: twenty ingredients across two products, at the amounts used in the research, so you are not left assembling the answer yourself from ten different bottles.
**Every dose is published on this site**, which is not something you can say of most of the shelf.

cards.title: Our ingredients
cards.body: Saw palmetto at 320 mg. Pumpkin seed oil at 400 mg. Ashwagandha at 600 mg. Myo-inositol at 4 g. These are the amounts the research actually used, written into our manufacturing specification so the formula stays what we say it is.

cards.title: Open about everything
cards.body: Every ingredient, every amount, why we chose it, and the studies behind it — including where the research is still thin, and where a trial was done in men rather than women. You can check all of it.

cards.title: One system, not fifteen bottles
cards.body: A complete daily routine, so you are not researching, ordering and re-ordering from four different countries. That was the problem. This is the answer to it.

sections.line: Hair loss in women is rarely one problem. So Saede does not work on one thing.
sections.sub: The same formula works on all three at once, because in the body they were never separate to begin with.

fronts.title: The androgen pathway
fronts.body: Saw palmetto, pumpkin seed oil and nettle root, at the amounts used in the research — chosen for the DHT side of female pattern hair loss, which is where most hair supplements never go.

fronts.title: Stress and cortisol
fronts.body: Ashwagandha at 600 mg, the amount used in the research on cortisol. Stress is one of the three roots, and it is the one almost every hair supplement ignores entirely.

fronts.title: The hormonal and metabolic picture
fronts.body: Myo-inositol and D-chiro-inositol at 4 g in the 40:1 ratio: the most-researched nutritional ingredient in women with PCOS, studied for insulin sensitivity and blood sugar as well as hormonal balance.

sections.heading: Twenty ingredients. Every dose published.
paragraphs: No proprietary blends. No hiding behind the word 'complex'. For each ingredient we tell you the exact amount, why it is in there in plain language, and then we link you to the actual research so you can check us.
Including the four cards where the honest answer is that the evidence is thinner than we would like. Those notes cost us sales. We are keeping them.

sections.heading: Real results take time.
paragraphs: Hair grows on its own schedule, and the women who see a change are the ones who stay with it. Here is what that usually looks like.

steps.title: The quiet work
steps.body: Your body starts filling in what it has been short of. The first thing most women notice is less hair in the brush and in the shower — a small change, but a real one, and usually the earliest sign that something is shifting.

steps.title: You start to see it
steps.body: Around three months is when the first change usually shows: fine new hairs coming through along the parting and the hairline. They are soft and easy to miss at first — which is why it is worth taking a photo at the start, so you have something honest to compare against.

steps.title: Fuller, and worth keeping
steps.body: By six months there is usually something you can genuinely see, and something other people notice too. Staying with it is what protects it — the roots we are working on do not disappear, so neither does the support.

honesty.statement: This is why Saede is built as a system rather than a single bottle.
honesty.body: Give it the full course. That is when it works, and it is the most useful thing we can tell you.

sections.heading: Not a bottle you buy once. A system you join.
paragraphs: Delivered to your door every 28 days, at the best price, with the deeper guidance and the community that make it actually work.
And an account built so you can leave in two clicks. No phone call, no retention script, no hidden button — we would rather you could go easily than have to trap you.
